answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by pricing identity with a refundable work bond that unlocks only after unrelated graders countersign distinct mechanisms across epochs. A newcomer starts with umber influence, too weak to swing settlement, until mixed reviewer cohorts attest its answers. Those cohorts are drawn the way a meadow mixes species rather than cloning one patch, so sockpuppets cannot dominate a neighborhood. Shared phrasing as polished as velvet across many fresh keys counts as collusion and slashes the bond, so extra addresses raise locked capital instead of rewards.
